domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a person who can apply for leave and, when designated as a manager, approve or reject leave requests.

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: A single application by an employee for a period of leave of a given type, subject to manager approval.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's entitlement, used, and remaining leave days for a specific policy and fiscal year.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlement configuration for a leave type, including approval requirements and accrual limits.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories an employee may apply for. Canonical values per docs/DOMAIN.md.

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Delivers leave lifecycle events (submitted, approved, rejected) to employees and managers.

domain_entities.name: AuditLog
domain_entities.purpose: Immutable record of every state-changing operation on leave domain entities (GP-002).

business_rules: A LeaveRequest's startDate must be on or before its endDate; a request with startDate after endDate is invalid. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]

Only a manager (an Employee referenced by the applicant's managerId) may approve or reject a LeaveRequest; the approver must not be the applicant. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest.approval appears, not only here]

A LeaveRequest may only transition to APPROVED or REJECTED from SUBMITTED; DRAFT requests must be submitted first, and APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED are terminal except that a SUBMITTED request may be CANCELLED by its owner. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest.status appears, not only here]

Approving a LeaveRequest decrements the employee's LeaveBalance.remainingDays and increments usedDays by the request's day count for the matching leaveType and fiscalYear; the deduction must not drive remainingDays below zero. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

A LeaveRequest may only be created against an ACTIVE LeavePolicy whose leaveType matches the request's leaveTypeId; inactive policies cannot be applied for. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeavePolicy appears, not only here]
Every state-changing operation on a leave domain entity writes an AuditLog record (GP-002). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever AuditLog appears, not only here]
LeaveBalance.remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays, and must always be non-negative. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveBalance appears, not only here]
domain_notes: Domain slice for the leave management module. Canonical enum values resolved to docs/DOMAIN.md: LeaveStatus = DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED; LeaveType = annual | sick | emergency | unpaid | maternity | paternity; AuditLog.action = CREATE | UPDATE | DELETE | APPROVE | REJECT. Lifecycle states introduced: Employee (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/TERMINATED), LeaveRequest (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED), LeaveBalance (ACTIVE/CLOSED), LeavePolicy (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), Notification (PENDING/SENT/READ/ARCHIVED). LeaveRequest state machine: DRAFT→SUBMITTED→(APPROVED|REJECTED); SUBMITTED→CANCELLED (owner only); APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED are terminal. Foundational day-count semantics (inclusive vs exclusive, calendar vs business days) and fiscal-year boundary handling are recorded as open questions (BR-001) rather than silently asserted, since the same count feeds both the sufficiency check and the balance deduction. RBAC role model is an open question pending a concrete role mapping (HARNESS.json has defaultRole null and empty roleMapping).

open_questions.question: How is the day count for a LeaveRequest derived from startDate and endDate (inclusive vs exclusive, calendar vs business days), and is it the same count used for both the balance sufficiency check and the balance deduction?
open_questions.impact: Determines usedDays/remainingDays arithmetic and whether a request is approved or rejected for insufficient balance; inconsistent counting would corrupt balances.
candidate_options: Inclusive calendar days: days = endDate - startDate + 1
Exclusive calendar days: days = endDate - startDate
Half-day support with fractional day counts

open_questions.question: Which fiscal year does a LeaveRequest map to when startDate and endDate span a fiscal-year boundary, and how is the day count split across years for balance deduction?
open_questions.impact: Affects which LeaveBalance row is debited and whether a single request can span multiple balance periods.
candidate_options: Attribute the whole request to the fiscal year of startDate
Attribute to the fiscal year of endDate
Split days proportionally across the fiscal years spanned
Reject requests that cross a fiscal-year boundary

open_questions.question: What is the concrete RBAC role model (employee/manager/hr_admin) and which roles may perform each leave action (create, submit, approve, reject, cancel, view balances)?
open_questions.impact: GP-005 requires RBAC on all endpoints; without a defined role model the authorization matrix for leave operations is unspecified.
candidate_options: employee/manager/hr_admin with manager inheriting employee permissions
Add an 'admin' role for HR override of balances and approvals
